searchText: Hi this isn't the right channel as it relates more to execution layer ethereum client development! Please check one of the other channels. Reminder for execution teams who want to move 4444s forward... 1. Is this a priority for your team? Yes 👍 /No 👍 2. If yes, who on your team is going to take on the engineering work. 3. Take a look at our specs so that we can have an informed discussion specs: https://github.com/ethereum/portal-network-specs/blob/master/history-network.md rough sketch of our suggested plan for delivery of 4444s by end of this year: https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/1052#issuecomment-2136877600

Reminder for execution teams who want to move 4444s forward...

1. Is this a priority for your team? Yes 👍  /No 👍 
2. If yes, who on your team is going to take on the engineering work.
3. Take a look at our specs so that we can have an informed discussion

specs: https://github.com/ethereum/portal-network-specs/blob/master/history-network.md
